profile.headline: Application Architecture, Software Development
profile.summary:
20+ years of experience delivering, modernizing, and stabilizing production systems. Strong background in .NET, SQL, and modern web technologies, known for quickly owning complex environments and modernizing legacy platforms without disrupting the business, while delivering measurable gains in performance, reliability, and maintainability for technical and non-technical teams alike. 

20+ years Microsoft development: .Net, SQL, SSRS, deep legacy product knowledge 
20+ years web development: Javascript, ReactJS, AngularJS, KnockoutJS, CSS, HTML 
20+ years legacy system rewrites and rebuilds, including VB6, Dynamics GP and Access
7+ years NodeJS, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, IoT 
8+ years team leadership experience utilizing Agile workflows

positions.title: Founder, Software Engineer
positions.description: I assist companies with planning, building and maintaining sustainable & scalable software solutions.

positions.title: Application Architect / Software Engineer
positions.description: Managed multiple accounts focusing on Microsoft Dynamics GP customization. Created multiple web and phone application projects, emphasizing on Dynamics GP integration utilizing Microsoft .net Framework.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: My goal was to increase the companies' e-commerce success and growth by suggesting and implementing new, sustainable technology. I was able to flex my frontend and backend development skill sets in many projects, often providing a faster, friendlier, user experience.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description: I lead design and development efforts of the product “Magpie”. A successful inventory management, pricing automation and e-commerce platform designed to assist Game store owners in managing and selling large collections of the popular Magic: The Gathering collectible card game.

company.name: Magpie Software Inc. (Acquired by TCGplayer.com, August 2014)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Oversaw multiple custom software development solutions for businesses within the Kandiyohi County and Greater Minnesota. Projects including data reporting and benchmarking, custom CRM platforms, and integration services for Accounting software.

Generated online presence for local business creating websites and rich online user experiences utilizing the popular Wordpress framework. I provided solutions ranging from theme creation, e-commerce, payment integration, custom plug-ins, REST services and data connectivity. 

Managed existing customer accounts in addition to seeking and creating new relationships and solutions.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Extended Microsoft Dynamics GP client projects, utilizing Dexterity framework and Microsoft .Net Addins. Managed SOAP Web services and ASP.net web projects.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Converted VB6 projects to the then-new Microsoft .Net Framework. Performed customization on the Microsoft Dynamics GP platform.
